company_overview: The Company was established based on the Deed of Establishment of Limited Liability Company PT Swayasa Prakarsa No. 09 dated January 12 2012 and began running commercially in 2014. The Company was founded as a motor for the commercialization of Gadjah Mada University (UGM) research results, as well as part of efforts to support the downstreaming and commercialization of research results and innovations to be transformed into competitive industrial products. The Company's business development was carried out in stages through the formation of several strategic business units. This development began with the Gama Herbal Indonesia Unit which carries out herbal product production activities. Furthermore, in 2014, the Company developed the Heprogama Unit as a medical device manufacturing unit. In 2017, the Company expanded its business activities through the Gamafood Unit which carries out health food production activities. Then, in 2022, the Company established the IMEDEV Distribution Unit to support distribution activities and strengthen the Company's business value chain.
